patterns.name: Page heading with actions
patterns.description: Page title with a primary action aligned to the right — the Pine equivalent of Sage PageHeading.
patterns.when: Top of any admin index or detail screen that needs a title plus one or more header actions (create, save, export).
patterns.code:
<pds-box fit direction="row" align-items="center" margin-block-end="md">
  <pds-text tag="h1">Agents</pds-text>
  <pds-box direction="row" gap="sm" justify-content="end" flex="grow">
    <pds-button variant="primary">
      <pds-icon slot="start" name="add" aria-hidden="true"></pds-icon>
      New chatbot
    </pds-button>
  </pds-box>
</pds-box>
notes: Replaces a Sage PageHeading with a PdsButton in its actions — compose this pds-box row in new Pine-only UI.
Actions live in a trailing pds-box with direction="row" gap="sm" justify-content="end" flex="grow" so buttons sit on the page end.
Icon-in-button uses slot="start" with a valid icon name (add), not the deprecated icon prop.
Pair with table-in-card below the heading on index pages.

patterns.name: Table in card
patterns.description: A responsive pds-table inside a rounded, shadowed pds-box — the standard wrapper for admin list tables.
patterns.when: Any admin data table that should read as a card on the page background rather than a bare grid.
patterns.code:
<pds-box border-radius="lg" shadow="100" display="block" fit>
  <pds-table component-id="expert-agents-table" responsive row-dividers>
    <pds-table-head background>
      <pds-table-head-cell>Name</pds-table-head-cell>
      <pds-table-head-cell>Status</pds-table-head-cell>
      <pds-table-head-cell>Created</pds-table-head-cell>
      <pds-table-head-cell>Actions</pds-table-head-cell>
    </pds-table-head>
    <pds-table-body>
      <pds-table-row>
        <pds-table-cell>Teaching Assistant</pds-table-cell>
        <pds-table-cell>Active</pds-table-cell>
        <pds-table-cell>Mar 3, 2026</pds-table-cell>
        <pds-table-cell>⋯</pds-table-cell>
      </pds-table-row>
    </pds-table-body>
  </pds-table>
</pds-box>
notes: In React: PdsBox borderRadius="lg" shadow="100" display="block" fit wrapping PdsTable responsive.

Put the pds-table-head-cell elements straight into pds-table-head, which is already the header row; don't wrap them in a pds-table-row. background adds a subtle fill to the head, and border adds top and bottom borders.
responsive enables horizontal scroll for wide column sets; row-dividers adds row separators.
Sits directly under page-heading-actions — no pds-container wrapper on typical full-width admin lists.

patterns.name: List page (heading + table)
patterns.description: Full admin index page: page heading with primary action, then a card-wrapped responsive table.
patterns.when: Resource index screens (agents, products, orders) with a create action and a data table.
patterns.code:
<pds-box direction="column" gap="md" fit>
  <pds-box fit direction="row" align-items="center">
    <pds-text tag="h1">Agents</pds-text>
    <pds-box direction="row" gap="sm" justify-content="end" flex="grow">
      <pds-button variant="primary">
        <pds-icon slot="start" name="add" aria-hidden="true"></pds-icon>
        New chatbot
      </pds-button>
    </pds-box>
  </pds-box>

  <pds-box border-radius="lg" shadow="100" display="block" fit>
    <pds-table component-id="agents" responsive row-dividers>
      <pds-table-head background>
        <pds-table-head-cell>Name</pds-table-head-cell>
        <pds-table-head-cell>Status</pds-table-head-cell>
        <pds-table-head-cell>Created</pds-table-head-cell>
      </pds-table-head>
      <pds-table-body>
        <pds-table-row>
          <pds-table-cell>Teaching Assistant</pds-table-cell>
          <pds-table-cell>Active</pds-table-cell>
          <pds-table-cell>Mar 3, 2026</pds-table-cell>
        </pds-table-row>
      </pds-table-body>
    </pds-table>
  </pds-box>
</pds-box>
notes: Composes page-heading-actions + table-in-card — the target Pine layout for admin list screens.
While migrating, teams may still use Sage PageHeading for the title row; replace it with the heading pds-box when touching the file.
Loading state: return <pds-loader is-loading size="md"></pds-loader> alone (see empty-and-loading). Zero rows: use empty-state-pine.

patterns.name: List page with filters
patterns.description: Index page with page heading, pds-filters bar, and card-wrapped table.
patterns.when: Index screens that need filtering before the table (automations, orders, contacts).
patterns.code:
<pds-box direction="column" gap="md" fit>
  <pds-text tag="h1">Automations</pds-text>

  <pds-filters>
    <pds-filter component-id="trigger" variant="default" text="Trigger" icon="flash"></pds-filter>
    <pds-filter component-id="action" variant="default" text="Action" icon="activity"></pds-filter>
    <pds-filter component-id="more" variant="more" text="More filters" icon="add-circle"></pds-filter>
    <pds-filter component-id="clear" variant="clear" text="Clear filters"></pds-filter>
  </pds-filters>

  <pds-box border-radius="lg" shadow="100" display="block" fit>
    <pds-table component-id="automations" responsive row-dividers>
      <pds-table-head background>
        <pds-table-head-cell>Name</pds-table-head-cell>
        <pds-table-head-cell>Trigger</pds-table-head-cell>
        <pds-table-head-cell>Status</pds-table-head-cell>
      </pds-table-head>
      <pds-table-body>
        <pds-table-row>
          <pds-table-cell>Welcome sequence</pds-table-cell>
          <pds-table-cell>Form submit</pds-table-cell>
          <pds-table-cell>Active</pds-table-cell>
        </pds-table-row>
      </pds-table-body>
    </pds-table>
  </pds-box>
</pds-box>
notes: In a working filter bar, each pds-filter slots its panel content and switches to variant="selected" once applied — this recipe shows the static trigger row.
Use variant="more" for overflow and variant="clear" for reset; icons should match filter semantics (flash, activity, add-circle).
Filters sit in the column flow between heading and table-in-card, separated by the parent gap.
Compose with page-heading-actions when the index also needs a header CTA.

patterns.name: Settings / edit form page
patterns.description: Admin edit form: page heading row with Save/Cancel, 60/30 body, field sections in card boxes.
patterns.when: Create/edit flows (coupons, offers, configuration) with header actions, stacked field sections, and an optional sidebar.
patterns.code:
<pds-box direction="column" gap="md" fit>
  <pds-box fit direction="row" align-items="center">
    <pds-text tag="h1">Edit coupon</pds-text>
    <pds-box direction="row" gap="sm" justify-content="end" flex="grow">
      <pds-button variant="secondary">Cancel</pds-button>
      <pds-button variant="primary">Save</pds-button>
    </pds-box>
  </pds-box>

  <pds-box direction="row" align-items="start" gap="lg" fit>
    <pds-box flex="1">
      <pds-box direction="column" gap="md">
        <pds-box direction="column" gap="sm" padding="md" shadow="100" border-radius="md" background-color="var(--pine-color-background-container)">
          <pds-text tag="h2" size="lg" weight="semibold">Details</pds-text>
          <pds-input component-id="coupon-code" label="Coupon code" value="SUMMER20"></pds-input>
          <pds-input component-id="coupon-name" label="Name" value="Summer sale"></pds-input>
        </pds-box>
        <pds-box direction="column" gap="sm" padding="md" shadow="100" border-radius="md" background-color="var(--pine-color-background-container)">
          <pds-text tag="h2" size="lg" weight="semibold">Discount</pds-text>
          <pds-input component-id="coupon-percent-off" label="Percent off" value="20"></pds-input>
        </pds-box>
      </pds-box>
    </pds-box>
    <pds-box flex="0 0 30%">
      <pds-box direction="column" gap="sm" padding="md" shadow="100" border-radius="md" background-color="var(--pine-color-background-container)">
        <pds-text tag="h2" size="lg" weight="semibold">Summary</pds-text>
        <pds-text color="var(--pine-color-text-secondary)">Review discount details before saving.</pds-text>
      </pds-box>
    </pds-box>
  </pds-box>
</pds-box>
notes: Heading row actions: pds-box direction="row" gap="sm" justify-content="end" flex="grow" wraps Cancel + Save.
Body row uses gap="lg" between main flex="1" and sidebar flex="0 0 30%".

Stack field groups in card boxes (padding="md" shadow="100" border-radius="md" background-color="var(--pine-color-background-container)") with an h2 section title (tag="h2" size="lg" weight="semibold") under the page's h1.
Give each pds-input a unique component-id. It becomes the id of the native input, which the label points at.
For narrow single-column settings, drop the split and use one stacked column of section cards instead.

patterns.name: Loading state (default)
patterns.description: Standalone pds-loader while async admin data loads — the default loading state for a list or detail screen.
patterns.when: Initial page load or refetch while a list/detail region is empty.
notes: Return <pds-loader is-loading size="md"></pds-loader> on its own while the query is loading — no extra wrapper.
For a labeled loader inside a panel or modal body, use the loading-inline-centered pattern instead.
Pair with empty-state-pine when data resolves to zero rows.

patterns.name: Loading state (inline, centered)
patterns.description: Centered loader with label inside a subsection — use when the loading region needs context (panel, modal body).
patterns.when: Loading a bounded region that should show a short status message with the spinner.
patterns.code: Loading agents…
notes: Put the message in the loader's label slot and add show-label to show it. The slotted text replaces the default "Loading..." inside the loader, which carries aria-live="polite"; a pds-text beside the loader sits outside it.
fit makes the box span its container, so align-items="center" centers the loader across the region.
Do not combine with empty-and-loading on the same screen — pick one recipe per loading state.
Pair with empty-state-pine when data resolves to zero rows.

patterns.name: Empty state (Pine)
patterns.description: Pine-native zero-data panel with a neutral-gray icon square, title, description, and stacked actions (primary above a secondary Learn more).
patterns.when: Replace Sage EmptyState on migrated admin screens when a list or table has no rows.
patterns.code:
<pds-box padding="xl" background-color="var(--pine-color-background-container)" border-radius="lg" direction="column" align-items="center" justify-content="center" gap="md" fit>
  <pds-box flex="none" border-radius="md" background-color="var(--pine-color-background-inset)" min-width="48px" min-height="48px" align-items="center" justify-content="center">
    <pds-icon name="file" size="24px" color="var(--pine-color-icon)"></pds-icon>
  </pds-box>
  <pds-box flex="none" direction="column" align-items="center" gap="xs">
    <pds-text weight="semibold" align="center" size="2xl">No documents</pds-text>
    <pds-text align="center" size="md" color="var(--pine-color-text-secondary)">Documents will display here once you add them.</pds-text>
  </pds-box>
  <pds-box flex="none" direction="column" gap="sm" align-items="stretch">
    <pds-button variant="primary">Upload documents</pds-button>
    <pds-button variant="secondary">Learn more</pds-button>
  </pds-box>
</pds-box>
notes: Layout: neutral-gray 48x48 icon square (no border) with a 24px icon, semibold 2xl title, md body copy, primary action stacked above a secondary Learn more button.
Screens that still use Sage EmptyState should move to this layout when the file is converted.
Pick a semantic icon (file, users, folder, add) and keep the badge as a neutral-gray square using --pine-color-background-inset so it stays theme-safe.
Use fit on the outer box so the empty panel spans the content area width.

Keep flex="none" on the badge, text, and actions boxes — the base .pds-box class sets flex-grow:1, so without it the 48x48 badge stretches (stops being square) and the sections spread apart in a tall panel.
